[DataTable_CollisionDefinitions]
; 00, 04, 05, and 17 are the general purpose collisions. The rest are used only rarely.
;  Byte 00:
     02: Full Collision
;  Byte 01:
     02: Tile covers lower half of sprites.
     04: Tile covers sprites.
     10: "Return" Tile.
     40: Special Event Tile
     80: Trigger Tile
; Byte 03:
     C0: Glove
     C1: Sword
     C2: 
     C8: Sword + Axe
     D0: Event Execute
     F0: Event Execute
